install_note: DaVinci Resolve itself is NOT in Homebrew (cask retired). Install via scripts/install_resolve.sh (~3.5 GB download, ~6 GB installed; Blackmagic requires name+email registration for either edition (Studio is ~8.4 GB and replaces the free app in place; its key is entered once at the screen); Apple Silicon needs Rosetta 2, the script handles it). Skill scripts are stdlib-only Python plus ffprobe.
